anchor: Each pool must therefore be provisioned on its own demand signal, and can be provisioned predictively, because the signal least visible to conventional autoscaling is also the most persistent: pretrained time-series models forecast it, zero-shot, at the horizons provisioning requires.
claim_text: Each pool must be provisioned on its own demand signal, which can be forecasted predictively by pretrained time-series models.

anchor: A characterization of production multimodal inference traffic as per-pool demand signals
claim_text: Production multimodal inference traffic is characterized as per-pool demand signals.

anchor: A zero-shot benchmark of time-series foundation models on serving demand signals
claim_text: Time-series foundation models are benchmarked zero-shot on serving demand signals.

anchor: A silicon-calibrated cost model for consumer-GPU vision encoding
claim_text: A silicon-calibrated cost model for consumer-GPU vision encoding is developed.

anchor: A calibrated two-pool simulation platform, and the saturation-knee result
claim_text: A calibrated two-pool simulation platform is developed, showing saturation knees an order of magnitude apart.

anchor: Baselines and the closed predictive-scaling loop
claim_text: Baselines and a closed predictive-scaling loop are established.

claim_text: The vision pool's cost model provides an exact batching law that enables a realistic cross-request batching policy and an analytic bound on inter-pool handoff latency.
